title: The Five-Step Process, Step 3: Intellectual Honesty and Diagnosing Root Causes
summary: Following apartment inspections, President Hughes highlights that while agency grants choice, consequences are fixed by natural law. He details Step 3 of the five-step process: diagnosing problems to find their root causes. This stage demands intellectual honesty, careful logical analysis over mere feelings, distinguishing close causes from deep root causes, and objectively acknowledging personal and interpersonal weaknesses.
